description: Sector overlay for federally incorporated not-for-profits, charities, foundations, associations, social enterprises, donor-funded bodies, and civil-society documentation in Canada.

metadata.scope: Canada-only sector overlay controls for NGO / Not-for-Profit. Intended to be used with canada_core_control_library.
metadata.source_note: Source basis verified against official Canadian federal/provincial/territorial legal and regulatory sources available through 2026-08-30. Draft or proposed measures and enacted provisions not yet in force, and regulator requirements with future compliance or enforcement dates are not treated as operative compliance obligations. This starter pack is not legal advice and requires expert validation before production reliance.
metadata.external_knowledge_policy: No external knowledge is introduced during document evaluation. Regulatory source mappings live only in this versioned rule pack.
